_comment: Film 41 Lyria 3.5 prompts (google/lyria-3.5, 0.10 USD per track, 6 tracks, 2026-11-24). Method as Film 67 / 66: one track per chapter; chapters = sections of timing.json (H,1 | 2,3 | 4,M | 5 | 6 | 7,A2 + end screen). Mysterious, not uplifting (drones, pads, piano, glass, distant choir). Files in /tmp/claude-0/f41/audio/music, not in the repo. Prompt sent = style + ' ' + 'A <len> track. ' + mood.
style: Instrumental underscore for a calm, serious editorial documentary about Bill Gates warning that artificial intelligence and robots will take most jobs, and his idea of a list of work reserved for humans. Mysterious and quietly unsettling, the feeling of standing at the edge of something large that is not yet decided: empty offices at night, screens glowing, a long road with three stops. Low warm drones, slow evolving dark pads, sparse felt piano notes far apart, glassy shimmering textures, a faint distant wordless choir like breath. No drums, no percussion, no beat, no lead vocals, no melody hook, not uplifting, not hopeful pop, not epic, not cinematic trailer, no big build-ups. Very quiet, narrow dynamic range, slow, made to sit under a speaking voice.

M0.chapter: H, 1 (Gates changed his mind, far fewer jobs, 'This is crazy', Human Reserved; FT Live C1, exceeds human intelligence, three stops)
M0.mood: mysterious and tense from the first second: a low sustained drone, a slow two-note felt piano figure that keeps asking the same question, cold glassy shimmer above; a man who has changed his mind; steady throughout, no build-up

M1.chapter: 2, 3 (stop 1 the screen: phone sales, support, accounting, young people; stop 2 hands: robots in 2-8 years, C2 Decoder, a decision)
M1.mood: cool and precise, slightly mechanical: a soft repeating muted piano pulse like a machine at work, dark pads underneath, faint metallic glass tones; a quiet unease that grows only a little; never driving

M2.chapter: 4, M (is he right? who is talking, the numbers, a forecast; subscribe call)
M2.mood: sober and weighing: a single sustained low string-like pad, sparse piano chords far apart, open space and silence between notes; thoughtful, neutral, a little darker at the end

M3.chapter: 5 (stop 3: twenty years of winners and losers, C3 Decoder; the tax on the machine's work, Etzioni; money cannot replace being needed)
M3.mood: deep and heavy, a long stretch of time: a very slow low drone that shifts like a tide, a distant wordless choir breathing in and out, a few dark piano notes; the weight of a whole working life; mysterious, no drama

M4.chapter: 6 (Human Reserved: children, jury, art; the 40 percent ceiling; who gets to decide; the price decides; draw your own line)
M4.mood: intimate and mysterious: glassy bell-like tones like a list being written in the dark, soft felt piano, a warm low pad, a faint choir far away; questioning and human, open, never resolving

M5.chapter: 7, A2 + end screen (abundance far away, purpose, the silence, who writes the list; closing call; 15 s end screen)
M5.mood: vast and still: a wide shimmering pad like a horizon at dusk, slow low drone, a few piano notes that do not resolve, a distant choir; the question left open; ends on a long decaying unresolved chord into silence
